answer.sql:
WITH ln AS (
  SELECT inv_id, SUM(qnt * unt_prc) AS rev
  FROM wwicryptic.sl.t_inv_lns
  GROUP BY inv_id
),
yr AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.inv_dt)::int AS y, SUM(ln.rev) AS rev
  FROM wwicryptic.sl.t_inv i
  JOIN ln ON ln.inv_id = i.inv_id
  WHERE i.inv_dt >= DATE '2014-01-01' AND i.inv_dt < DATE '2016-01-01'
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.inv_dt)::int
)
SELECT ROUND(
  (100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN y = 2015 THEN rev END) - SUM(CASE WHEN y = 2014 THEN rev END))
   / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN y = 2014 THEN rev END), 0))::numeric, 1
) AS growth_pct
FROM yr
LIMIT 501
